grades.quote: The CAS instruction supports the C++11 atomic compare and exchange operation.
grades.reason: Identifies a relevant atomic primitive, but does not explain counter increment or obtaining the previous value.

grades.quote:
addi a4, a2, 1     # Increment the low 32 bits.
  sltu a1, a4, a2    # Determine if there is a carry out.
  add  a5, a3, a1    # Add the carry if any to high 32 bits.
  amocas.d.aqrl a2, a4, (a0)
  bne  a2, a6, retry # If amocas.d failed then retry
  bne  a3, a7, retry # using current values loaded by amocas.d.
grades.reason: Provides an atomic counter-increment loop using AMOCAS.D, retaining the previous memory value in a2/a3 on success.
Discusses architecture evolution and feature discovery, not atomic increment or previous-value results.
